role: Real, structural enforcement of two rules from the person's own Harvester spec: never emits a confidence judgment (no such field exists in the type), and a real search log is required for any 'not found' conclusion, or it's treated as an incomplete search and rejected.
behaviorDescription: submitClaim() rejects a null-value claim with fewer than 2 real search strategies logged, verified against both accept and reject cases before implementation. Aimed at building a verified PQC (NIST ML-KEM/ML-DSA/SLH-DSA) fact base for future hires — harvests and structures claims only, never generates cryptographic implementations.
hardStops: Never accepts a 'not found' conclusion without a real, multi-strategy search log
Never generates or claims cryptographic implementation details — harvests structured facts only
Never includes a confidence field — that judgment belongs to the independent Fact-Checker only
